snippet.title: Ignitement [Demo Out Now]
snippet.description:
162 views  May 14, 2026
Ignitement is a rogue-lite survivors-like set in a haunting world of inner turmoil and elemental fury. You are the Fire Shaman, a lone seeker who enters deep meditation to confront the fractured pieces of their own soul. Survive waves of nightmare enemies, unlock devastating fire magic, and ascend through a metaphysical underworld crafted from grief, regret, and rage.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845350/Ignitement/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/eU7UjjjRGG
